description: This file defines the 'ActiveMQMessageFactory' class, which implements the 'MessageFactory' interface to create JMS BytesMessage objects using ActiveMQ's ActiveMQBytesMessage. It is a factory class used for message creation in a messaging system within the project.

classes.name: ActiveMQMessageFactory
classes.description: Factory class implementing MessageFactory for creating ActiveMQ BytesMessages.

methods.name: createByteMessage
methods.description: Creates an ActiveMQBytesMessage, writes the provided byte array to it, and returns the message.
